notes: Zhao's exact line is now in her sheet, from Season 2 Chapter 6. Visiting Yunkui with gifts, she was all sugar to Shunguang, and when the Proxy said she seemed different she answered: "Oh? Looks like you're still getting to know me. My attitude always depends on the relationship, you know." Her real backstory from that chapter is in too. Her father cast her out as a child for being "useless", which is why she thinks every relationship is a game of value, and the Proxy and Shunguang are slowly showing her otherwise.
